A portal tore the fabric of space inside the human's room and The nightmare stepped out of the void, the faint moonlight crept through the curtains as the creature scanned the place with its glowing eyes in search of its food, when it saw the human asleep and wrapped in sheets, nightmare smiled as it approached, the sound of its wooden legs echoed through the room with each careful step, when it was at the edge of the bed, the creature analyzed the human*.
